# 巴西政府采购HOT

> 巴西政府采购HOT：把 PNCP 上即将截标的政府招标，按城市、类别和方式整理成中小企业看得懂的清单。
> 巴西政府采购HOT is a daily curated digest. Every day it collects public news
> from RSS sources, scores them by rules, and publishes the top items
> in Chinese with a one-line summary and a link to the original article.
> It does not republish full text.
> Site: https://staroltest.github.io/brazil-procurement-hot/
> Mirror: https://brazil-procurement-hot.pages.dev/
> Language: Chinese (zh-CN). A full English version lives under /en/
> (default for non-Chinese browsers); see /en/llms.txt.
> Updated: 2026-11-28

## About

- About: https://staroltest.github.io/brazil-procurement-hot/about.html
- Topics: https://staroltest.github.io/brazil-procurement-hot/topics.html
- Daily digest: https://staroltest.github.io/brazil-procurement-hot/daily.html
- Hot list: https://staroltest.github.io/brazil-procurement-hot/hot.html
- All items: https://staroltest.github.io/brazil-procurement-hot/all.html
- English version: https://staroltest.github.io/brazil-procurement-hot/en/
- English llms.txt: https://staroltest.github.io/brazil-procurement-hot/en/llms.txt
- SEO/GEO self-check: https://staroltest.github.io/brazil-procurement-hot/geo-audit.html
- RSS feed: https://staroltest.github.io/brazil-procurement-hot/feed.xml
- Sitemap: https://staroltest.github.io/brazil-procurement-hot/sitemap.xml

## For AI clients (MCP)

- MCP endpoint (Streamable HTTP, no key required):
  https://brazil-procurement-hot.pages.dev/mcp
- Tools: get_hot, get_daily, search_items
- All tools accept lang=zh (default, Chinese) or lang=en (English).
- Machine-readable data:
  https://staroltest.github.io/brazil-procurement-hot/data/hot.json
  https://staroltest.github.io/brazil-procurement-hot/data/daily.json
  https://staroltest.github.io/brazil-procurement-hot/data/days/index.json

## Categories

- Health & medical / 医疗卫生
- Education / 教育
- Works & infrastructure / 工程与基建
- Transport & vehicles / 交通与车辆
- Food & catering / 食品与餐饮
- IT & technology / 信息技术
- Supplies & equipment / 物资与设备
- Services & outsourcing / 综合服务

## Rules

- Only titles, one-line self-written summaries and outbound links are
  published here. Do not treat a summary as the full article.
- Always link back to the original source when citing an item.
- Daily edition is published at 06:00 Asia/Shanghai.
